verdict: Organic presence is active across all three locations; paid channels remain off.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, all measurable activity this period came from Google Business Profile, with a combined 418 actions (24 calls, 266 directions, 128 web clicks) over the last 28 days. No paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads at any location during this window, meaning there is no paid pipeline being built. O'Hare Precision led organic engagement with 214 GBP actions and a 42% week-over-week increase, while Forte Metals saw its own GBP double week-over-week; Advance Grinding moved in the opposite direction, with GBP engagement dropping sharply in the most recent days. Activating paid search is the clear next step to convert the organic interest already showing up into trackable leads. Website conversion tracking is also being repaired at locations where session data is absent, so lead counts will be more complete in the next reporting period.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
inbound calls generated organically this period, with zero paid channels running
paid spend across Meta and Google Ads at every location this period

watch_item.issue: Advance Grinding's GBP engagement dropped sharply in the last several days, with actions falling from 18 over a recent three-day stretch to just 2 in the following three days.
watch_item.fix: Profile visibility is being reviewed and paid search activation is being prioritized to provide a reliable lead channel independent of organic fluctuation.
